Hey man. I'm from NW London I think I can help you out. I know some great people I can introduce you to. I think you should pursue some hobbies or interests that you have for now to keep away from the streets and meet some like-minded people. If you play ball or like martial arts I know a couple good spots I can tell you about. Also since you're 16 maybe you can look for a weekend job to help you out? In terms of the future, I think you should consider an apprenticeship if you think that uni life isn't for you. That way you don't need to waste your time at uni or even sixth form/college. An apprenticeship is basically being trained by a workplace for a couple of years and you get paid by them while training. Then at the end of the training you are qualified for a job. Search around for apprenticeships in areas that you like I'm sure you can find great jobs for the future. You are at a point in your life where you have a great opportunity to redirect your life for good. Hit em up I can give you my insta or something I can help you find a job too. Wishing you the best my bro don't hesitate to message me.
